items.title: 67750_Sippie Wallace oral history interview
items.q: I remember Jelly Roll Morton, but he was a older man than I was, you know.

ctx.x: When we were talking about that big O.K. night, was Jelly Roll Morton there? Do you remember if he was there or not?
I remember Jelly Roll Morton, but he was a older man than I was, you know.

items.title: 67750_Sippie Wallace oral history interview
items.q: Now, Jelly Roll -- she sang 'Jelly Roll Blues.'

ctx.x: Well, I'll send you a tape with some of those -- Butter Beans and Susie on it.
(Inaudible). Now, Jelly Roll -- she sang "Jelly Roll Blues." And I went to a Methodist
Church on Woodward Avenue and they wanted me to sing "Jelly Roll Blues."
